## Natural Language Input
You can call from another workflow, hit the chat endpoint, or even hit from another Discord bot if you wanted to! Any natural language command should work fine - let me know if you manage to break something and I will look at updating the template!

## Tool enabled agent
If you are going to swap the model out, just make sure that it's one that can handle tools. No special system prompt should be needed for the large cloud models, if you go with a quantized model via Ollama then you might need to coax it a bit.

## Discord MCP Client/Server
This is totally customizable (you can connect it to any MCP server by changing the URL), but if you need a starting point, you can check out my "Manage your discord server with natural language from anywhere" template as a starting point.

# Discord MCP Chat Agent

## Purpose and structure
This folder contains the **Discord MCP Chat Agent** workflow. Its executable nodes use `agent`, `chatTrigger`, `lmChatOpenAi`, `mcpClientTool`. The table and connection map below are derived from the JSON, not an inferred guarantee of behavior.

## Setup
Import inactive. Configure your own credentials and replace REPLACE_WITH_* values. Review external destinations and Code nodes before running.

## Entry points
When chat message received
